_comment: Copy to config/mcp-gateway.json (gitignored) and adjust. Each upstream is a stdio MCP server the gateway spawns and exposes as <name>__<tool>. write_tools, destructive_tools and open_world_tools set the MCP tool annotations clients use for approval prompts.

papers._comment: The paper library: https://github.com/polarizetech/paper-library. Install it with its [mcp] extra so that paperlib-mcp is on PATH, or give an absolute path.

pipeline._comment: Optional: the full pipeline, with verifier models, as start/status/result tools.

web_search._comment: Optional SearXNG base URL for web__search. SEARXNG_URL in the environment overrides it.

network._comment: Host headers accepted in addition to loopback, for a front end that presents a different Host (e.g. a Docker bridge). The bind itself stays on 127.0.0.1.
